title: Haak Vineyards & Winery
gap: Prices for tours, tastings, stays, and events not stated
blurb: Haak Vineyards & Winery has three locations in Texas: Santa Fe, Brenham, and Odin's Table at the Texas Renaissance Festival. Guests can enjoy peaceful vineyard escapes, guided wine tastings, and lively events. The winery has won over 570 national and international awards and offers a free wine club membership with exclusive benefits.
